summary: Advance the incremental sync watermark only when every consumed record was stored: extract/hydration failures AND silently-skipped records (scalar deletion tombstones) both hold the watermark. UpsertBatch counts a record stored only after its typed-table projection succeeds, so typed failures also hold the watermark for retry.
reason: Greptile P1 on publish PR #1668: sync --resources deleted (scalar keys) advanced the watermark past records that were never stored, excluding them from all future incremental runs.
validated_outcome: extractFailureTotal > 0 or consumedTotal != totalCount leaves the watermark untouched (SaveSyncProgress preserves the prior watermark); build/tests pass.
